cards.audioText: Your callsign is UAL835, you are now at Guangzhou Control area, maintaining 8100 meters, over ATAGA, squawk 5703, contact Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航835，你现在在广州区调范围，8100米保持，过ATAGA，应答机5703，联系广州区调。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL835, maintaining 8100 meters, over ATAGA, squawk 5703.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航835，在8100米保持，过ATAGA，应答机5703。

cards.audioText: UAL835, radar contact. Proceed direct to WXI, climb and maintain 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，雷达识别了，直飞WXI，上9500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Direct to WXI, climb and maintain 9500 meters, UAL835.

cards.audioText:
UAL835, what is your estimated time for WXI?
[Tell controller your estimated time for WXI is 0635Z.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，预计什么时候过WXI？
[告诉管制员，预计过WXI的时间是06:35Z。]
cards.referenceText: Estimated time for WXI is 0635Z, UAL835.

cards.audioText: Your weather radar shows a red area 50 miles in front of you, you want to offset 5 miles to the right to avoid the thunderstorm, ask Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示，前方50英里有雷暴，你想右偏5海里来飞避雷暴，请求广州区调。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL835, request offset 5 miles to the right to avoid thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航835，请求右偏5海里避开雷暴。

cards.audioText: UAL835, offset 5 miles to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，同意右偏5海里，飞离天气后报。
cards.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, wilco, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意右偏5海里，照办，美联航835。

cards.audioText:
UAL835, due to temporary airspace limitations, reduce to mach decimal 72.
[Tell ATC mach decimal 72 is not acceptable for you, it's too slow for your aircraft. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，由于目前空域限制，减小马赫数至0.72。
[告诉管制员，无法减小至马赫数0.72，对你的飞机来说太慢了。]
cards.referenceText: negative, unable mach decimal 72, too slow for us, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，无法马赫数0.72，对我们来说太慢了，美联航835。

cards.audioText: UAL835, reduce to mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Guangzhou control area.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，减小至马赫数0.75，我们正在限制进入广州区调范围的飞机数量。

cards.audioText: UAL835, turn right heading 230, maintain 10100 meters, contact Wuhan Control 121.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，右转航向230，保持10100米，联系武汉区调121.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 230, maintain 10100 meters, contact Wuhan Control 121.6, good day, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向230，保持10100米，联系武汉区调121.6，再见，美联航835。

cards.audioText: You are cruising 10100 meters, over OBLIK, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在10100米巡航，过OBLIK，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, cruising 10100 meters, over OBLIK, squawk 5703.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，在10100米巡航，过OBLIK，应答机5703。

cards.audioText: UAL835, Wuhan control, descend to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，武汉区调，下8400米保持，到达到后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下8400米保持，到达后报，美联航835。

cards.audioText: As you were descending, you executed TCAS climbing maneuver, report this situation to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，你执行了TCAS爬升机动，将此情况报告给武汉。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 835, we executed TCAS climbing maneuver as we are descending.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，在下降过程中，我们执行了TCAS爬升机动。

cards.audioText: Now the conflicting traffic is clear, you resumed descend, tell ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你和冲突航空器已解除冲突，继续下降，告诉管制员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, we are clear of traffic, we resumed descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，我们摆脱冲突，继续下降。

cards.audioText: The purser tells you, during the maneuver, there are 5 passengers injured, 2 of them are injured very seriously. Inform Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长告诉你，在机动期间，有5名乘客受伤，其中2名受重伤，告诉武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, we have 5 passengers injured, and 2 are very serious during the TCAS maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，在机动期间，我们有5名乘客受伤，其中2名受重伤。

cards.audioText:
Roger, UAL835, what is your intention?
[The injured passengers are bleeding seriously, You request priority landing at Wuhan airport, and request ambulance on arrival. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，你的意图是什么？
[受伤的乘客流血严重，你请求在武汉机场优先着陆，并在着陆后请求救护车。]
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆，并在着陆后请求救护车，美联航835。

cards.audioText: UAL835, priority landing approved, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，同意优先着陆，预计雷达引导，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Priority landing approved, radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意优先着陆，雷达引导，ILS进近，跑道36右，美联航835。

cards.audioText: You have captured the localizer for runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower, confirm medical assistance is ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 你截获了跑道36右的航向道，联系武汉塔台，证实医疗救援已就位。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL835, localizer established runway 36R, confirm medical service is ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航835，建立跑道36右的航向道，证实医疗救援已就位。

cards.audioText: Affirm, UAL835, ambulance and doctors are waiting at the gate, cleared to land, runway 36R, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 是的，救护车和医生正在机坪等候，可以落地，跑道36右，地面静风。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land, runway 36R, thank you, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，可以落地，跑道36右，谢谢，美联航835。
